senses.gloss: नेय [nēya], a. Fit to be carried. -Comp. -अर्थ (क) a. (a word or sentence) having a sense that can be only guessed; ग्राम्यो$प्रतीतसन्दिग्धनेयार्थनिहतार्थता S. D.
To be led, managed, guided, governed.
Fit to be taught; Mb.5.74.4. (com. अनेयः शिक्षयितु- मयोग्यः).
To be spent or passed (as time).
नेयधी [nēyadhī], a. Of manageable or tractable character; Rāj. T.
